name: tlc
description: Type like Chuck - one more AI autocomplete tool

enumDescriptions: External OpenAI-compatible server from the Base URL setting
TLC-managed local engine: a llama.cpp llama-server started by the extension (downloaded on demand)
tlc.mode.description: Completion source. Use "TLC: Select Mode" to switch; switching to local downloads the engine and model on first use.

enumDescriptions: llama.cpp llama-server with GGUF models (default; all platforms)
Bundled OpenVINO GenAI runner with native IR models (Windows/Linux x64; NPU/GPU/CPU)
Bundled MLX runner with 4-bit mlx-community models (macOS arm64; Metal)
tlc.local.engineKind.description: Local engine implementation (local mode only). The ovgenai runner ships with the extension and downloads the OpenVINO runtime libraries on first use. The mlx runner ships with the extension and needs no downloads at all. Default: `mlx` on macOS arm64, `llama.cpp` elsewhere (until this setting is set explicitly).

tlc.local.model.description: Local engine model (local mode only). Use "TLC: Select Local Model" to pick, or "From disk…" for a local model file/directory without downloading. The catalog ships Qwen2.5-Coder; each entry carries its own FIM template and download directory so other model families can be added without Qwen-specific assumptions.

tlc.local.device.description: Inference device for the local engine (local mode only). `auto` follows GPU → CPU; an explicit `npu` is supported by the ovgenai runner (falling back through GPU to CPU) and redirected to GPU with a warning for the llama.cpp engine. The mlx engine always runs on GPU (Metal), regardless of this setting. Use "TLC: Select Local Device".

tlc.openai.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1). Run "TLC: Test Connection" to verify the URL and load the model list from the server.

tlc.openai.model.description: Model name sent in completion requests. Use the "TLC: Select Model" command to pick one from the server's /v1/models list.

tlc.openai.apiKey.markdownDescription: Optional API key for the completions API (plaintext; e.g. for synced settings). When non-empty it takes precedence over the key stored via the "TLC: Set API Key" command, which keeps the key in VS Code secret storage — the recommended way.

tlc.autoTrigger.description: Trigger completions automatically after a typing pause. When off, completions are only requested via the manual shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+Space).

tlc.debounceMs.description: How long (in milliseconds) typing must pause before an automatic completion request is sent.

tlc.pendingGraceMs.description: How long (in milliseconds) typing past a pending request waits for its result before discarding it and requesting afresh after the debounce pause. 0 never waits.

tlc.cacheEnabled.description: Re-serve the last completion without a new API request: at the exact cursor position, and when the typed text extends it along the same line as its prefix (the remainder is served).

tlc.cacheTtlMs.description: Lifetime of the cached completion in milliseconds.

tlc.contextMaxLength.description: Maximum combined prefix+suffix context (characters). Filled automatically from /v1/models in remote mode; local engines' windows are known from the built-in catalog and the NPU is capped separately via tlc.local.npuContextMaxLength. 0 means unlimited. When exceeded, the prefix and suffix budgets are scaled proportionally with priority to the prefix.

tlc.prefixContextMaxLength.description: Maximum number of characters of code before the cursor sent as context.

tlc.suffixContextMaxLength.description: Maximum number of characters of code after the cursor sent as context.

tlc.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

enumDescriptions: User-defined template from the Prefix / Suffix / Middle / Stop settings below
tlc.promptTemplate.description: Built-in FIM prompt template, or "custom" to use the markers from the Prefix / Suffix / Middle / Stop settings below.

tlc.prefix.markdownDescription: Marker placed before the code prefix. Used when Prompt Template is `custom`. Editing this field switches Prompt Template to `custom`; selecting a built-in template clears the stored marker fields.

tlc.suffix.markdownDescription: Marker placed before the code suffix. Used when Prompt Template is `custom`. Editing this field switches Prompt Template to `custom`; selecting a built-in template clears the stored marker fields.

tlc.middle.markdownDescription: Marker placed after the suffix, where generation begins. Used when Prompt Template is `custom`. Editing this field switches Prompt Template to `custom`; selecting a built-in template clears the stored marker fields.

tlc.stop.markdownDescription: Reserved tokens used as stop sequences and masked in user code, comma-separated. Used when Prompt Template is `custom`. Editing this field switches Prompt Template to `custom`; selecting a built-in template clears the stored marker fields.

tlc.local.npuContextMaxLength.description: Context window used on the NPU (local mode only). The NPU graph is compiled for this window: a smaller window compiles faster, generates faster and needs less memory; it also caps the prefix/suffix prompt budgets when the NPU is used. 0 uses the model's full context.

tlc.local.apiKeyEnabled.description: Require the per-session key from engine clients. Keep enabled; turn off only to call the engine directly (e.g. curl) without the key.

tlc.local.llamaCppRelease.description: llama.cpp release tag used for the local engine download (llama.cpp engine).

tlc.local.engineBinary.description: Path to a locally unpacked llama-server binary to use instead of downloading (local mode only). When set, no engine is downloaded.

tlc.local.distroDir.description: Locally unpacked engine distribution to use instead of downloading (local mode only): an OpenVINO GenAI runtime folder for the ovgenai kind, or an unpacked llama.cpp build for llama.cpp. Ignored by the mlx kind. When set, no engine download happens; before the first download the extension offers picking such a folder.

tlc.local.engineDir.description: Directory for the downloaded engine (llama.cpp build or the OpenVINO GenAI runtime; local mode only). Empty uses the extension storage. Changing it moves the existing engine; "TLC: Reset Local Engine…" re-downloads.

tlc.local.modelDir.description: Directory for the downloaded models (GGUF or OpenVINO IR; local mode only). Empty uses the extension storage. Changing it moves downloaded models.

tlc.local.modelCacheDir.description: Directory for the local model cache (local mode only). Empty uses the extension storage.

tlc.local.modelPath.description: Path to a local model file or directory to use instead of downloading (local mode only). A GGUF file for the llama.cpp engine; an IR .xml file (with its .bin alongside) or a model directory for ovgenai; an mlx model directory for mlx. When set, no model is downloaded.

tlc.local.modelUrls.markdownDescription: Per-model download URL overrides (local mode only), keyed by model id: `{ "1.5b": "https://mirror/.../model.gguf" }`. For the ovgenai engine, key individual IR files as `1.5b/openvino_model.bin` to override OpenVINO IR file URLs.

tlc.local.huggingfaceUrl.description: Base URL for model downloads (local mode only). Change it to an alternative Hugging Face endpoint or a mirror.

tlc.local.githubUrl.description: Base URL for llama.cpp release downloads (local mode only). Change it to a GitHub mirror.

tlc.local.openvinoUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenVINO GenAI runtime download used by the ovgenai engine (local mode only). Change it to a mirror of storage.openvinotoolkit.org.

tlc.yieldToCopilot.description: When GitHub Copilot inline completions turn on, TLC disables itself and notifies; when Copilot turns off, TLC re-enables only if it was disabled by this auto-reaction (a manual toggle is never overridden).

tlc.forbiddenFileNames.description: Glob patterns of files in which completions are disabled (e.g. .env, *.secret).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run check-types && npm run lint && npm run compile -- --production
scripts.test: npm run unit && npm run compile && npm run compile-tests && npm run vscode-test
scripts.build: npm run test && npm run lint
scripts.package: npm run vscode:prepublish && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/fetch-runner-binaries.mjs && vsce package --no-dependencies
